blocks.text: Harakat yo'nalishi: up, into, over, through ...

109-darsdagi predloglar narsaning **qayerda turganini** aytadi. Bu darsdagilar esa **harakat yo'nalishini** ko'rsatadi: qayerga, qayerdan, qaysi yo'l bilan. O'zbek va ingliz tillari bu yerda butunlay boshqacha ishlaydi. O'zbekchada yo'nalish ko'pincha **fe'lning o'zida** bo'ladi: kirmoq, chiqmoq, tushmoq, o'tmoq, aylanmoq; harakat usuli esa ravishdosh bilan: yugurib **kirdi**, suzib **o'tdi**. Ingliz tilida aksincha: fe'l harakat **usulini** aytadi (run, walk, swim, drive, fly), predlog esa **yo'nalishni**: She **ran into** the room — U xonaga yugurib **kirdi**; He **swam across** the river — U daryoni suzib **o'tdi**.

rows: walk **up** the hill, run **down** the stairs
go **into** the shop, get **out of** the car
jump **over** the wall, walk **under** the bridge
devordan sakrab o'tmoq, ko'prik tagidan o'tmoq

blocks.text: **up** — yuqoriga (up the stairs, up the hill, up a tree), **down** — pastga (down the stairs, down the mountain). **into** — biror joyning **ichiga** kirish: go **into** the room, put the milk **into** the fridge. **out of** — ichidan tashqariga: come **out of** the bank, take the phone **out of** your bag. Farqni eslang: **in** — joy (The cat is **in** the box — qutida), **into** — harakat (The cat jumped **into** the box — qutiga sakrab tushdi). «out from» emas, **out of**.

items.text: Kamola ran **up** the stairs to answer the phone.
items.translation: Kamola telefonga javob berish uchun zinadan yugurib **chiqdi**.

items.text: Put the shopping **into** the car, please.
Two men came **out of** the bank in a hurry.

blocks.text: **over** — biror narsaning ustidan oshib yoki ustidan o'tib: jump **over** the fence, fly **over** the sea, climb **over** the wall. **under** — tagidan o'tib: the boat went **under** the bridge. **through** — biror narsaning **ichidan** o'tib, bir tomondan kirib boshqa tomondan chiqish: **through** the tunnel, **through** the forest, **through** the crowd, **through** the window. O'zbekchada **through** ko'pincha «... dan o'tib» yoki «... orqali» bo'ladi: deraza**dan** qaradi — looked **through** the window.

items.text: The children climbed **over** the wall into the garden.
We drove **through** a small village without stopping.

blocks.text: **across** — biror yuzani bir chetidan narigi chetiga **kesib** o'tish: **across** the road, **across** the river, **across** the square. **along** — uzunasiga, chiziq bo'ylab: **along** the street, **along** the beach, **along** the canal. **round** (yoki **around**) — aylanib: **round** the lake, **round** the corner, **round** the world. **past** — biror narsaning **yonidan o'tib** ketish: walk **past** the shop. **towards** — biror narsa **tomon**, unga yaqinlashib: run **towards** the door.

items.text: We sat on a bench and watched the boats sailing **along** the canal.
items.translation: Skameykada o'tirib, kanal **bo'ylab** suzayotgan qayiqlarni tomosha qildik.

items.text: The postman walked **past** our house without stopping.
items.translation: Pochtachi uyimiz**ning yonidan** to'xtamay o'tib ketdi.

items.text: A little girl ran **towards** her grandmother with open arms.
items.translation: Kichkina qiz quchog'ini ochib buvisi **tomon** yugurdi.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I went out from the house.» → **I went out of the house.**; «He entered into the room.» → **He went into the room.** yoki **He entered the room.** (enter dan keyin predlog yo'q); «cross across the road» → **cross the road** yoki **go across the road**; «walk on the river» (bo'ylab) → **walk along the river**; «She came in the room.» (harakat) → **into the room**.

Tarjima usuli: inglizcha **fe'l** = «qanday?» (yugurib, suzib, uchib, mashinada), **predlog** = «qayerga?» (kirdi, chiqdi, o'tdi). ran **into** → yugurib **kirdi**; flew **over** → uchib **o'tdi**; swam **across** → suzib **o'tdi**; walked **out of** → yurib **chiqdi**.
Bog'lanish: joy predloglari (in, at, on, under, behind ...) — 106–109-darslar; to (yo'nalish), get to — 108-dars; go in, get out, fall off kabi frazali fe'llar — 114–115-darslar.

items: **up** / **down** — yuqoriga / pastga: up the stairs, down the hill;
**into** / **out of** — ichiga / tashqariga: into the room, out of the car;
**over** / **under** — ustidan / tagidan: over the wall, under the bridge;
**through** — ichidan o'tib: through the tunnel, through the window;
**across** — kesib o'tib; **along** — bo'ylab; **round** — aylanib; **past** — yonidan; **towards** — tomon;
inglizcha fe'l — harakat usuli, predlog — yo'nalish; o'zbekchada yo'nalish fe'lda (kirmoq, chiqmoq, o'tmoq).

examples.title: **up** and **down**: the stairs, the hill
examples.description: **up** — yuqoriga, **down** — pastga: walk **up** the hill (tepalikka chiqmoq), run **down** the stairs (zinadan yugurib tushmoq). O'zbekchada yo'nalish fe'lda: chiqmoq, tushmoq.

sentences.text: We walked **up** the hill to watch the sunset.
sentences.translation: Quyosh botishini tomosha qilish uchun tepalik**ka chiqdik**.

sentences.text: Be careful when you go **down** the stairs — they're wet.
sentences.translation: Zinadan **tushayotganda** ehtiyot bo'ling — ular ho'l.

sentences.text: The lift isn't working, so we'll have to walk **up** the stairs.
sentences.translation: Lift ishlamayapti, shuning uchun zinadan piyoda **chiqishimizga** to'g'ri keladi.

sentences.text: The children ran **down** the hill, laughing and shouting.
sentences.translation: Bolalar kulib, qiyqirib tepalikdan yugurib **tushishdi**.

sentences.text: A cat climbed **up** the tree and couldn't get down.
sentences.translation: Mushuk daraxt**ga tirmashib chiqdi** va tusha olmadi.

sentences.text: Tears were running **down** her face.
sentences.translation: Uning yuzi**dan** ko'z yoshlari oqib **tushardi**.

sentences.text: Is it hard to cycle **up** that road? — Yes, it's very steep.
sentences.translation: U yo'ldan velosipedda **yuqoriga chiqish** qiyinmi? — Ha, juda tik.

sentences.text: Aziz fell **down** the stairs and hurt his knee.
sentences.translation: Aziz zinadan yiqilib **tushdi** va tizzasini lat yedirdi.

sentences.text: Go **up** these steps and you'll see the entrance on your left.
sentences.translation: Shu zinapoyalardan **chiqing**, chap tomonda kirish eshigini ko'rasiz.

sentences.text: Every morning Madina jogs **up** and **down** the street outside her house.
sentences.translation: Madina har kuni ertalab uyi oldidagi ko'chada **u yoq-bu yoqqa** yuguradi.

examples.title: **into** and **out of**: going in and out
examples.description: **into** — ichiga (harakat), **out of** — ichidan tashqariga: walk **into** the room, get **out of** the car. **in** — joy, **into** — harakat.

sentences.text: Dilnoza walked **into** the kitchen and switched on the kettle.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza oshxona**ga kirib**, choynakni yoqdi.

sentences.text: Get **out of** the car — we're here!
sentences.translation: Mashina**dan tushing** — keldik!

sentences.text: A bird flew **into** the classroom through the open window.
sentences.translation: Ochiq derazadan sinf**ga** qush uchib **kirdi**.

sentences.text: James took his phone **out of** his pocket and called a taxi.
sentences.translation: Jeyms cho'ntagi**dan** telefonini **chiqarib**, taksi chaqirdi.

sentences.text: Don't jump **into** the pool — it isn't deep enough.
sentences.translation: Basseyn**ga sakramang** — u yetarlicha chuqur emas.

sentences.text: Pour the milk **into** a pan and heat it slowly.
sentences.translation: Sutni kastryulka**ga quying** va sekin isiting.

sentences.text: Everybody ran **out of** the building when the fire alarm went off.
sentences.translation: Yong'in signali chalinganda hamma bino**dan yugurib chiqdi**.

sentences.text: I put the money **into** an envelope, and now it's **in** my drawer.
sentences.translation: Pulni konvert**ga solib qo'ydim**, hozir u tortmam**da**.

sentences.text: Bekzod looked **out of** the window and saw that it was snowing.
sentences.translation: Bekzod deraza**dan** tashqariga **qaradi** va qor yog'ayotganini ko'rdi.

sentences.text: Can you help me carry these heavy boxes **out of** the car and **into** the house?
sentences.translation: Bu og'ir qutilarni mashina**dan olib**, uy**ga olib kirishga** yordam berasizmi?

examples.title: **over** and **under**: jumping, flying, walking
examples.description: **over** — ustidan oshib / ustidan o'tib: jump **over** the fence, fly **over** the mountains. **under** — tagidan o'tib: walk **under** the bridge.

sentences.text: The horse jumped **over** the wall easily.
sentences.translation: Ot devor**dan** osongina **sakrab o'tdi**.

sentences.text: We flew **over** the Alps on our way to Italy.
sentences.translation: Italiyaga ketayotib Alp tog'lari **ustidan** uchib o'tdik.

sentences.text: The boat went **under** the old bridge.
sentences.translation: Qayiq eski ko'prik **tagidan** o'tdi.

sentences.text: Our ball went **over** the fence into the neighbours' garden.
sentences.translation: To'pimiz devor**dan oshib**, qo'shnilarning bog'iga tushdi.

sentences.text: Our cat crawled **under** the car to hide from the rain.
sentences.translation: Mushugimiz yomg'irdan yashirinish uchun mashina **tagiga** emaklab kirdi.

sentences.text: Can you climb **over** that gate, or is it too high?
sentences.translation: Anavi darvoza**dan oshib o'ta** olasizmi yoki u juda balandmi?

sentences.text: Here the river flows **under** the road through a big pipe.
sentences.translation: Bu yerda daryo katta quvur orqali yo'l **tagidan** oqib o'tadi.

sentences.text: A helicopter flew low **over** our house this morning.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab vertolyot uyimiz **ustidan** past uchib o'tdi.

sentences.text: Tom tripped **over** a stone and dropped all his shopping.
sentences.translation: Tom tosh**ga qoqilib**, barcha xaridlarini tushirib yubordi.

sentences.text: To get to the platform, go **under** the railway through the tunnel, then up the stairs.
sentences.translation: Perronga chiqish uchun temir yo'l **tagidagi** tunneldan o'ting, keyin zinadan ko'tariling.

examples.title: **through**: in one side and out the other
examples.description: **through** — ichidan o'tib: bir tomondan kirib, ikkinchi tomondan chiqish. through the tunnel, through the forest, through the window. O'zbekchada: «... dan o'tib», «... orqali».

sentences.text: The train went **through** a long tunnel.
sentences.translation: Poyezd uzun tunnel**dan o'tdi**.

sentences.text: We walked **through** the park to get to the museum.
sentences.translation: Muzeyga borish uchun park **orqali** yurib o'tdik.

sentences.text: A thief got into the house **through** the kitchen window.
sentences.translation: O'g'ri uyga oshxona derazasi**dan** kirdi.

sentences.text: It took us two hours to drive **through** the city because of the traffic.
sentences.translation: Tirbandlik sababli shahar **ichidan** o'tishimizga ikki soat ketdi.

sentences.text: The sun was shining **through** the curtains.
sentences.translation: Quyosh nuri pardalar **orasidan** tushib turardi.

sentences.text: Water was coming **through** a hole in the roof.
sentences.translation: Tomdagi teshik**dan** suv kirib kelayotgan edi.

sentences.text: Look **through** the window — can you see the mountains?
sentences.translation: Deraza**dan** qarang — tog'larni ko'ryapsizmi?

sentences.text: The road to Shakhrisabz goes **through** some beautiful mountains.
sentences.translation: Shahrisabzga boradigan yo'l go'zal tog'lar **orasidan** o'tadi.

sentences.text: Madina pushed her way **through** the crowd to find her son.
sentences.translation: Madina o'g'lini topish uchun olomon **orasidan** yo'l ochib o'tdi.

sentences.text: Please go **through** that door and wait in the room on the left.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, anavi eshik**dan** o'ting va chap tomondagi xonada kuting.

examples.title: **across** and **along**
examples.description: **across** — bir tomondan narigi tomonga kesib o'tish: across the road, across the lake. **along** — uzunasiga, bo'ylab: along the river, along the street.

sentences.text: Look both ways before you walk **across** the road.
sentences.translation: Yo'l**ni kesib o'tishdan** oldin ikki tomonga qarang.

sentences.text: We walked **along** the river for an hour.
sentences.translation: Bir soat daryo **bo'ylab** sayr qildik.

sentences.text: My grandfather once swam **across** the lake.
sentences.translation: Bobom bir marta ko'l**ni suzib o'tgan**.

sentences.text: There are lots of cafés **along** the beach.
sentences.translation: Sohil **bo'ylab** ko'plab kafelar bor.

sentences.text: Emma ran **across** the street to say hello to us.
sentences.translation: Emma biz bilan salomlashish uchun ko'cha**ning narigi tomoniga** yugurib o'tdi.

sentences.text: Walk **along** this street and you'll see the bank.
sentences.translation: Shu ko'cha **bo'ylab** yuring, bankni ko'rasiz.

sentences.text: The ferry takes you **across** the lake in twenty minutes.
sentences.translation: Parom sizni ko'l**ning narigi tomoniga** yigirma daqiqada olib o'tadi.

sentences.text: Aziz drove slowly **along** the narrow mountain road.
sentences.translation: Aziz tor tog' yo'li **bo'ylab** sekin haydadi.

sentences.text: Can you help the old lady get **across** the street?
sentences.translation: Keksa ayolga ko'cha**dan o'tishga** yordam bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: Every evening people walk **along** the canal and chat with their neighbours.
sentences.translation: Har kuni kechqurun odamlar kanal **bo'ylab** sayr qilib, qo'shnilari bilan suhbatlashadi.

examples.title: **round**, **past** and **towards**
examples.description: **round** (= around) — aylanib: round the lake, round the corner. **past** — yonidan o'tib: go past the school. **towards** — tomon: walk towards the station.

sentences.text: We cycled **round** the lake in an hour.
sentences.translation: Bir soatda ko'l **atrofini** velosipedda aylanib chiqdik.

sentences.text: Turn left and go **past** the school.
sentences.translation: Chapga buriling va maktab**ning yonidan** o'ting.

sentences.text: A big dog was running **towards** us, so we stopped.
sentences.translation: Katta it biz **tomonga** yugurib kelayotgan edi, shuning uchun to'xtadik.

sentences.text: The bus goes **past** our house, but it doesn't stop there.
sentences.translation: Avtobus uyimiz**ning yonidan** o'tadi, lekin u yerda to'xtamaydi.

sentences.text: Sarah's dream is to travel **round** the world.
sentences.translation: Saraning orzusi — dunyo **bo'ylab** sayohat qilish.

sentences.text: Walk **towards** the river and you'll find the market on your right.
sentences.translation: Daryo **tomon** yuring, bozor o'ng tomoningizda bo'ladi.

sentences.text: The car drove **past** us very fast and disappeared.
sentences.translation: Mashina yonimiz**dan** juda tez o'tib, ko'zdan g'oyib bo'ldi.

sentences.text: There's a bakery just **round** the corner from my flat.
sentences.translation: Kvartiram yonidagi muyulish**dan o'tishingiz bilan** novvoyxona bor.

sentences.text: When I saw Tom, he was walking **towards** the station with a big suitcase.
sentences.translation: Tomni ko'rganimda, u katta chamadon bilan vokzal **tomon** ketayotgan edi.

sentences.text: We walked **round** the old town of Khiva and then went **past** the famous blue minaret.
sentences.translation: Xivaning eski shahri **bo'ylab** aylanib chiqdik, so'ng mashhur moviy minora **yonidan** o'tdik.

examples.title: Giving directions: **along**, **past**, **across** ...
examples.description: Yo'l ko'rsatish — harakat predloglari eng ko'p kerak bo'ladigan vaziyat: go along, go past, go across, go over the bridge, go round the corner.

sentences.text: How do I get to the museum? — Go **along** this street to the traffic lights.
sentences.translation: Muzeyga qanday borsam bo'ladi? — Shu ko'cha **bo'ylab** svetoforgacha yuring.

sentences.text: Go **across** the square and take the first street on the left.
sentences.translation: Maydon**ni kesib o'ting** va chap tomondagi birinchi ko'chaga kiring.

sentences.text: Walk **past** the post office, and the hotel is right in front of you.
sentences.translation: Pochta**ning yonidan** o'ting, mehmonxona naq ro'parangizda bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Go **over** the bridge and turn right.
sentences.translation: Ko'prik**dan o'ting** va o'ngga buriling.

sentences.text: Keep going **up** the hill — the school is at the top.
sentences.translation: Tepalik bo'ylab **yuqoriga** yuravering — maktab cho'qqida.

sentences.text: The station? Go **down** this road and **round** the corner.
sentences.translation: Vokzalmi? Shu yo'ldan **pastga** tushing va muyulish**dan buriling**.

sentences.text: Follow the signs and walk **through** the shopping centre to the car park.
sentences.translation: Belgilarga qarab, savdo markazi **orqali** avtoturargohga o'ting.

sentences.text: When you come **out of** the metro, turn left.
sentences.translation: Metro**dan chiqqach**, chapga buriling.

sentences.text: You can't miss it — just walk **towards** the tall blue tower.
sentences.translation: Adashmaysiz — baland moviy minora **tomon** yuravering.

sentences.text: Is it far? — No, just go **along** the river for five minutes and you're there.
sentences.translation: Uzoqmi? — Yo'q, besh daqiqa daryo **bo'ylab** yursangiz, yetib borasiz.

examples.title: Mixed: Emma's morning run
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: bitta hikoyada harakat predloglari — out of, down, along, across, through, over, round, past, towards, up, into.

sentences.text: At six o'clock Emma comes **out of** her house in her running shoes.
sentences.translation: Soat oltida Emma sport poyabzalida uyi**dan chiqadi**.

sentences.text: First she runs **down** the hill to the river.
sentences.translation: Avval u tepalik**dan** daryo tomon **yugurib tushadi**.

sentences.text: Then she jogs **along** the river for about two kilometres.
sentences.translation: Keyin daryo **bo'ylab** taxminan ikki kilometr yuguradi.

sentences.text: She runs **across** an old wooden bridge.
sentences.translation: U eski yog'och ko'prik**dan yugurib o'tadi**.

sentences.text: After that, she goes **through** a small forest, where it's always quiet.
sentences.translation: Shundan keyin u doim jimjit bo'ladigan kichik o'rmon **ichidan** o'tadi.

sentences.text: Sometimes she has to jump **over** a fallen tree.
sentences.translation: Ba'zan yiqilgan daraxt **ustidan sakrab o'tishiga** to'g'ri keladi.

sentences.text: Next she runs **round** the lake and **past** the old church.
sentences.translation: So'ng ko'l **atrofidan** aylanib, eski cherkov **yonidan** o'tadi.

sentences.text: A friendly dog often runs **towards** her, wagging its tail.
sentences.translation: Ko'pincha bir mehribon it dumini likillatib, u **tomon** yugurib keladi.

sentences.text: The hardest part is running back **up** the hill to her house.
sentences.translation: Eng qiyin qismi — uyiga qaytishda tepalik**ka yugurib chiqish**.

sentences.text: At seven she walks **into** the kitchen, tired but happy, and makes breakfast.
sentences.translation: Soat yettida u charchagan, lekin xursand holda oshxona**ga kiradi** va nonushta tayyorlaydi.
